name: Kerry O'Neill
bio:
Kerry O'Neill is an exceptionally talented tattoo artist with a focus on the illustrative style, whose work speaks volumes of their advanced skill level. Operating out of Bulldog Tattoo in Butler, NJ, Kerry's attention to detail and artistic finesse are unmatched, consistently delivering tattoos that perfectly capture the visions of their clients. With their professional approach and dedication to their craft, Kerry has earned a distinguished reputation in the tattooing community.
